_comment: Phase 3 item database (ROADMAP.md Phase 3 'first 20 items'), extended by Phase 5 Stage 2 (scripts/shop_db.gd's town-store catalog). Loaded by scripts/item_db.gd. Each entry: type in [seed, crop, resource, food, tool]; stack_max caps a slot's count (tools are always 1 and instead carry durability_max, consumed via scripts/inventory.gd damage_selected_tool()); icon is a res:// path to real PixelLab art or "" when this phase ships a flat-color placeholder instead (see placeholder_color/placeholder_label, drawn in-engine by hud.gd — no PNG for those, per CLAUDE.md scope guidance to keep icon art tractable this phase). value is Credits (unused by any Phase 3 system, seeded then for this exact stage's shop/shipping-box work). description is new this stage — only added to the items Marta's store actually sells (scripts/shop_db.gd's STOCK_IDS); ROADMAP's 'UI shows name/description/price' checklist line needs it there and nowhere else needs it yet. Tool value fields were ALSO missing entirely until this stage (tools never had a Credits price because nothing sold them) — all 5 got one for schema completeness, priced within the same 1-30 scale every other item already uses: hoe/watering_can share the 50-durability_max tier (24 Cr each); axe/pickaxe share the lower 40-durability_max tier, so they wear out faster and are priced a bit higher (28 Cr each) since each swing eats more of the tool's lifetime; the Scavenger's Bag's durability_max is 999999 (functionally unbreakable) so it gets a value (20 Cr) for completeness but is deliberately NOT in Marta's stock — 'replacement tool' has no meaning for something that can't break. See scripts/shop_db.gd's own header for the full stocked-roster reasoning.

seed_mutant_potato.name: Mutant Potato Seeds
seed_mutant_potato.description: Sturdy tuber seeds bred to shrug off bad soil and worse weather. Plant, water, wait.

seed_dustwheat.name: Dustwheat Seeds
seed_dustwheat.description: Grain that took the dust storms personally and grew tougher for it.

seed_ironroot.name: Ironroot Seeds
seed_ironroot.description: A dense root crop that grows slow but keeps forever. Reliable, like a good friend.

seed_sunbloom.name: Sunbloom Seeds
seed_sunbloom.description: A cheerful flowering crop that still turns to face a sun half the town swears got dimmer.

preserved_food.name: Preserved Rations
preserved_food.description: Tinned rations, pre- or post-war depending who you ask. Restores 25 energy, asks no questions.

cooked_meal.name: Wasteland Stew
cooked_meal.description: A proper hot stew, made from whatever the pantry had strong opinions about. Restores 40 energy.

hoe.name: Hoe
hoe.description: An honest tool for honest dirt. Tills soil for planting.

watering_can.name: Watering Can
watering_can.description: Dents and all, it still holds water — which is the only requirement, honestly.

axe.name: Axe
axe.description: For trees that had it coming. Chops wood.

pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
pickaxe.description: Cracks stone and ore loose the old-fashioned way.
